title: Trinity Verifier Report
description: Authoritative shape for any verifier verdict (layers 1-4). See docs/specs/TRINITY_VERIFIER_CONTRACT_V1.md §5. RecordProxy-aligned: audit_event reference uses the 13-field per-session shape (TRINITY_AUDIT_EVENT_SPEC_V1 §2); capture_refs links the verdict to the captures that produced its evidence (§5.1).

verdict.description: Closed verdict set per .ai/policies/verifier-rules.yaml §verdicts. RecordProxy outcomes (ORPHANED_INVOCATION, FAILED_PARTIAL, RECONCILED, ARCHIVED) are mapped into this set per TRINITY_VERIFIER_CONTRACT_V1 §2.1.

tier.description: Operational risk classification of the gated workflow.

rule_set.description: Rule-set ID from .ai/policies/verifier-rules.yaml or 'policy'/'llm_judge'/'human'. RecordProxy-alignment v2 added: orphaned_invocation, capture_finalize_missing, capture_missing_for_artifact, sandbox_profile_missing (TRINITY_VERIFIER_CONTRACT_V1 §4).

evidence_keys.description: Predicate names evaluated (deterministic) or empty for non-deterministic layers.

capture_refs.description: ULID list of captures.capture_id rows backing the evidence (TRINITY_VERIFIER_CONTRACT_V1 §5 + §5.1). MAY be empty for session-level verdicts before any capture started, or when the verdict fires on sandbox_profile_missing/capture_missing_for_artifact (in which case notes MUST explain). On COLD tier, an empty array requires a notes explanation.

step_id.description: Step id; null for session-level verdicts.

notes.description: Required when verdict in {RETRY, NEEDS_HUMAN, DEAD}; constraint enforced by aggregator, not schema. For RECONCILED source, notes.reconciled=true required; for HOT-degraded ORPHANED, notes.degraded=true required (TRINITY_VERIFIER_CONTRACT_V1 §5).

audit_event.description: Reference to the corresponding event in the per-session AuditWriter chain (TRINITY_AUDIT_EVENT_SPEC_V1 §2 — 13-field shape). Replaces the legacy {type, hash} reference; the new shape unambiguously identifies the event by event_id + session-scoped seq, allowing cross-verification against capture.sqlite audit_events table.

event_id.description: Per-event UUID4 hex; matches AuditWriter._event_id() pattern.

schema_version.description: Audit event schema version constant; pins to RecordProxy v1 (recordproxy/schemas.py).

seq.description: Session-scoped monotonic sequence; UNIQUE(session_id, seq) per capture_store.py.
